tour.p3.s1.title: Welcome to Orebit Resource!
tour.p3.s1.body: This tool estimates a block-model resource from composite samples (output of Assay). 12-tab pipeline: variography → block model → kriging → KCMI report.
tour.p3.s2.title: Upload composites
tour.p3.s2.body: Upload composite-domains.csv from Assay. Demo data preloaded so you can explore without a file. Domain tags D1-D4 are auto-detected.
tour.p3.s3.title: Variography
tour.p3.s3.body: Compute experimental variogram and fit a model (spherical/exponential/Gaussian). Auto-fit suggests nugget, sill, range. QA: nugget ratio under 50% is healthier.
tour.p3.s4.title: Block model
tour.p3.s4.body: Auto block-size scaling based on average drillhole spacing. Set anisotropy from variogram ranges. Octant search defaults follow industry practice.
tour.p3.s5.title: Estimation + 🎯 Cross-Val
tour.p3.s5.body: Three estimators: IDW, Ordinary Kriging, Nearest Neighbour. Cross-validation compares MAE/bias to choose. Swath plots check for conditional bias.
tour.p3.s6.title: Classification + 📜 KCMI Report
tour.p3.s6.body: Screen block confidence from kriging variance, distance and neighbour count, then build the KCMI 2017 Section 1 working narrative and grade-tonnage curve. The confidence tiers are computational only; Measured/Indicated/Inferred are assigned by a Competent Person.
